r.경제 체제: Party-led market economy · hydropower and mineral exports
r.생활 물가 수준: 29% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Trucks 36%, Jet engines, gas turbines 13%, Cars 8%, Cereal products 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Wood 44%, Jet engines, gas turbines 17%, Fertilizer 14%, Precision and medical instruments 10% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-ASEAN FTA (in force 2007); RCEP (in force for Korea since 2022; multilateral)
r.여행경보: Parts of the country: Travel ban · Rest of the country: Exercise caution
r.정치 구도: A one-party state led by the Lao People's Revolutionary Party.

t.why: As the link between China and Southeast Asia, it opened the China-Laos railway in 2021. It sells electricity from Mekong dams to its neighbors.
t.rel: A landlocked country surrounded by five neighbors including China, Vietnam and Thailand. The China-built Laos-China railway and heavy loans have deepened its dependence on China.
t.know: During the Vietnam War in the 1960s and 70s it became one of the most heavily bombed countries in the world, and unexploded bombs are still being cleared.
t.etext: It sells electricity from Mekong hydropower to its neighbors and exports copper and gold. Heavy debt from building the railway to China has caused its currency to fall sharply.
